provenanceNotes: Both runs record parent HEAD 95feaa7b0ff48f6b4085b020ee2e5ac2b47b9011 while stage changes were uncommitted; they have different source fingerprints.

The serve-visual-qa version used for these captures excluded public/materials. After all captures finished, the tool added this path for future fingerprints; the server was not restarted and existing evidence was not rewritten. The separate manifest SHA-256 and actual map hashes below identify material assets for this run.
Server-start source hashes alone are not served-bundle proofs. This file records the unmodified capture metadata and separately verified shipping material bytes.

The archive has nine original renderer PNGs and five original browser JPEGs (one walk, four production UI), copied byte-for-byte. Browser source files carried .png suffixes despite JPEG encoding; archive suffixes are corrected to .jpg without conversion. No cropping, relighting or retouching.
limitations: Single warmed roughly 8-second High 1920x1080 samples on Radeon Pro 560X / Chrome154; no repeated-run significance or universal FPS guarantee.
Citizen FPS and p95 regress; street p95 also worsens. Reduced calls/textures do not establish across-the-board performance improvement.
Render calls and triangles include multipass submissions, not unique scene geometry.
The Water Street continuous walk uses 601x781 render dimensions; its FPS is not comparable to the matched 1080p samples.
Nearby regional counts describe geographic coverage, not on-screen visibility, surveyed gable geometry, exact landscaping or enterable lobbies.
Lighting captures log valid poses and material readiness but do not independently report architecture/detailReady metrics.
The 60-second route and bounded cache observations do not establish exhaustive collision correctness or memory-leak freedom.
Night/twilight street surface detail remains dark; residential repetition/plain ground and coarse distant vegetation remain visible.
Frontage cost report is an earlier all-potential-cell CPU inventory, not final camera submission or complete current GPU-memory accounting.

Artist edits changing brick/paver/shingle/cladding course layout require updating the manifest pattern/distant-course fallback contract; controlled exporter edits did not exercise pattern topology changes.
Production portrait/landscape/compatible UI checks used desktop browser viewport overrides, not a physical mobile GPU, touch performance, or additional gameplay interaction test.

high-water-street-detail-walk.protocol: One 60s continuous actual W-input walk along the audited 300.432m Water Street arterial route. One initial placement; no position or heading rewrites during the measured leg. Live collision and protected-surface preflight remain mandatory. Setup/reset distance is excluded from walking metrics. Within each leg the test never rewrites position or heading. Five-second resource snapshots, real move rejection counters and controller simulation dt are recorded. Hidden/context-lost/disposed/cancelled runs abort and clear input. This is not exhaustive collision testing, a memory-leak proof, or a 30/60 FPS guarantee. Optional Chromium JS heap is GC-dependent. Render counters include multipass work.
